name: Sepulcher
source:
Within "Sepulcher" you follow a young man called Miron, who has taken the events  of his life into his own hands. In the aftermath of his actions, he claims refuge at the worn down cathedral in his village and begins to pray.

[from [url=https://thesleepingdead.itch.io/sepulcher]itch.io[/url]]
